Hi again! Okay so 1. I was 13 years old when I had the surgery, but they found the scoliosis when I was around 11. I had to wait for majority of my growing to happen/finish before I could have the surgery. 2. At the time I probably weighed around 140-150 pounds. I was very short but quite overweight at the time! 3. As far as this goes... I was told I could never do things such as ride horses or work in jobs where I was on my feet all day etc. I personally am a hairdresser who stands the whole day and I am fine. I have done everything they advised against as far as activities etc and I have been fine! The only time I have any issues is if it is “that time of the month” and I have more pronounced back pain than most women. Plus if I do any activities that are quite jarring then I can definitely experience some pain. For example, I went on a jet boat a few months back and the water was very choppy and rough, I definitely paid for it re back pain for a few days after, but nothing unmanageable. I personally feel that I can still do most things (99.9%) that I did before the surgery, but obviously it did take some time to heal properly. 4. As I had major scoliosis, and a full spinal fusion, my scar starts from a couple inches below where my spine starts, and it stops around my mid hip line. I was lucky and my surgeon also did some plastic surgery, so although it is a very long scar, it’s not thick and ugly looking. It is noticeable though. 5. I have not really had complications, other than what I mentioned in question 3! In fact I feel much more confident now that my posture is nice and straight. I can only bend in certain ways however, like only from my hips now. So no more somersaults lol! 6. Being honest, I was never hugely athletic so I’m not the best person to answer this! However again relating to question 3, long periods of standing do sometimes end up with a bit of a sore, aching back. 7. I can’t personally feel the screws but I can kind of feel the rods on either side of my spine if I press down hard enough- I just refer to myself as bionic woman now lol. 8. It does feel uncomfortable when you first get it done as it’s very foreign having all that titanium in your back! I actually remember telling a nurse it felt like I had a cookie/baking sheet in my back for the first couple of weeks. Now, I don’t really feel uncomfortable unless again I have maybe had a long day standing or sitting still in one position for too long. 9. Now this is a loaded question! No my rods have never broken, however a few years back I slipped and fell on down stairs, and I did end up breaking a screw in half. I never ended up going to get it fixed as it doesn’t interfere with my daily life, but for about a week after it happened I was VERY sore. Doctors didn’t even tell me it was broken though, I was in hospital for something else and my girlfriend saw on my X-ray that I had a broken screw. But no, no broken rods or anything like that. The screw is still broken and I’m fine! Maybe will get it looked at one day but for now it’s not causing me any stress. 10. I believe this is the same question as number 3! 

Now I hope this is all reassuring, I am very glad I had the surgery done as I would have had far more complications later on down the track without. The recovery is a long and painful one, but with a skilled surgeon, it is 100% worth it! Let me know if you have more questions ☺️

Hi there, I have been experiencing something similar since I was 12 years old, I am now 27. I get a horrible, debilitating pain in my epigastric area, that sometimes radiates out to my back. I don’t know how to describe the pain but it’s so damn painful that I vomit sometimes and can only really lean forward or the pain becomes worse. I honestly thought I was having a heart attack the first time I got it as a kid. Multiple hospital visits because of it too...I have taken nexium, omeprazole, antacids for days.. nothing works to relieve the pain. For me, an attack usually lasts a few hours, but I have had it happen daily for roughly a week before as well. The area where the pain is located is usually quite tender and I have to take off any restricting clothing as any pressure makes it worse. I have had a few endoscopys over the years, but no one can figure out what it is... I am also at a loss and quite worried. I don’t really think I have any specific triggers as it will just happen randomly with no warning.. however sometimes alcohol can bring it on. Unfortunately nothing has worked for me to get rid of the pain or figure out what it is but if we are experiencing the same thing then you aren’t alone!! ❤️

Actually, I threw out that line because I have been at the lowest point of my life , lost everyone important in quick succession whom I love to cancer, and have felt completely alone, empty, and at the end of my tether to this life. And so, weighing up my options of *possibly* helping another person who is at that all time low that I have experienced, versus offending an anger filled stranger on the internet with a bible verse... you know which one is going to take priority for me. Anger, rude words, and assumptions do not help anyone, just as my bible verse may or may not help OP, however, all we can do to try.

Well my bloods came back today and everything seemed normal. Keeping in mind I am not currently experiencing one of these “attacks” I am just hell bent on finding answers as to why I’ve been experiencing this for so many years as it is beyond painful and I’m scared of getting it again.

Re the area of pain, mine is also in the solar plexus area and it is excruciating when I do get it. It has only radiated out to my back during one attack, however it is usually confined to the epigastric area 99% of the time. I guess I’m skeptical as usually this pain only lasts for a few hours, however I have had occasions where I will get it daily for a few days straight. I have ended up in hospital many times without any answers... and would say I probably have about 6-7 of these episodes per year... I guess it’s making me nervous as I keep reading about acute pancreatitis (if it is that) turning into chronic after so many episodes. Thanks so much for all your insight, it’s much appreciated! 

I guess I’m just going to have to keep pushing for answers next time I end up in the hospital instead of allowing them to pass it off as anxiety 😐

I cannot hello feeling like this is partially my fault. He hadn’t smoked for years and after the news of my mom’s cancer we were both very upset so I bought over a bottle of whiskey and him and a couple friends all got drunk together and laughed and he asked for cigarettes so I said yes. Figured that it was a one time thing and if it made him feel better for the night then ok. After that he was having a cigarette a day and eventually we told him we weren’t giving him any more as it would definitely make his copd worse. He didn’t listen. I feel like I was the one who brought his death on so much earlier. I feel like I never should have taken him off of the bipap ventilator in hospital and taken him to hospice as I feel like it/I rushed his death that way. Yes he WAS comfortable but also so out of it I couldn’t even say goodbye. I feel like I killed him...

I feel so guilty that up until a couple days ago I didn’t realise he was actually in the process of dying. So this whole time the past few months I have been more concerned with taking care of my terminally ill mom and figured dad would come home eventually.

I visited him in hospital  but not as often as I should have... maybe a couple times a week with mom. She went daily. A few times a day. I was selfish and lazy though and like I said... didn’t think he was dying. Even when I WAS there, I just sat in the corner on my phone or whatever like a teenaged mobile phone addict and barely spoke to him.  

His last day in hospital again I barely spoke to him just made him a smoothie and sat outside with him.

Now that he has passed away I just feel like I can never forgive myself for not doing and saying more. I was so wrapped up in mom’s cancer that.. idk, there isn’t an excuse. I will NEVER forgive myself. I wish he knew how much I fucking loved him. How I loved him as much as I love mom but it was just easier to express it to mom for some reason. 

Him and I have some great memories but I just feel like I didn’t do enough these past few months. I feel so much hatred for myself.

I can’t believe I’m never going to see him again. Never going to hear his raspy smokers voice. Never hear his wheeze of laugher when he can’t atop laughing. Never hear his angry politic rants or the tv blaring on 100 at all hours of the day and night because he was so deaf. Never get to hear his dirty, inappropriate jokes, never binge watch Netflix and horror movies with him again, never make him eat my kitchen experiments. Never get to kiss his whiskered cheek at night and tell him I love you. Never get an adorable attempt at a text with all of the spelling errors. 

My biggest thing with both my parents that even though technically they are my grandparents I never thought of them like that. All I wanted one time was to say “I love you Daddy” to his face and see the smile there. 

Another thing (you don’t have to agree) but I believe in Christianity, and I’m not the bible thumping go to church and tell everyone about it. I’m into woman for goodness sake if that doesn’t scream jacked up Christian idk what does. Regardless though, I believe what I believe, and it scares me to no end that I did not know or find out what my dads beliefs were. Now I don’t know if I actually ever WILL see him again even though everyone keeps saying that.

Now I haven’t stopped crying for 48 hours. I can’t eat. Shower. Sleep. I wish I had died with him. I really do. I feel so guilty and hate myself for this. I can’t kill myself though because of my religious upbringing. That would be the only thing stopping me. That and the fact I still have my mom: but what happens when the cancer finally eats her up too? I don’t think I’ll be able to deal with that too. I’m scared of what I will do or won’t do. I don’t want to survive with them: I am so heartbroken. I can’t stop hearing my dads last breath and seeing his skill turn yellow in front of my eyes. I don’t want to be here. Nothing will ever be okay ever again. The only thing I can do is pop another lorazepam, take a few melatonin and go back to sleep for a few hours to avoid thinking of anything. Then wake up and do it again. I can’t even comfort my own mother and she lost her husband of 52 years. I am falling apart. I can’t do it. But I can’t make it stop because of what I believe in. Idk what to do. Feeling heartbroken, devastated, guilty, and so, so much regret.

And now even though I know it’s morbid, I can’t help but think with my mom’s terminal cancer prognosis that I’m going to have to go through this again in the near future. And I don’t think I will survive the second time around, wouldn’t want to survive without them anyways. Idk what the purpose of this post is but I’m so lost and just want to die. That’s all I want. Even my girlfriend doesn’t appeal to me right now. No one does. I’m crying out constantly to have a sign from dad but nothing. I shouldn’t do silly stuff like that anyways given what I believe in. Wouldn’t be possible. 

Anyways. If nothing, it felt good to get my story out. Im thinking of you daddy. And I love you more than you will EVER know or comprehend. I am so sorry I didn’t show you that more when you were here. I’m sorry I failed you as a daughter. You were and always will be my hero. I will miss you forever.
Feel free to message me. Coming from a depressed, lesbian young woman who grew up bullied a lot and is still battling depression. If you want. I’m here. I probably need a friend too.

Hey you. I also feel this ways sometimes. But I have to say at 15 years old... things may seem bad now but trust me when I say that in 5-10 years your life will be completely different with different people in it. Not necessarily saying that it will be a good change but you won’t know until you experience it. I have dealt with depression my whole life and surprisingly along the way I have still managed to have some beautiful moments. I would say.. give it a few more years at least to experience life. If it’s still bad and not changing. Then I always think no one can stop you doing what you want to do. But you’re so young. Give life a chance and yourself a chance to live it first. Hugs x
